stories.headline: FDIC and OCC Both Want to Be Stablecoins’ New Boss

stories.headline: Fed flags overheated markets as top stability risk
stories.body: The Federal Reserve's April financial stability report found that asset valuations remain elevated, even as investors are beginning to demand more compensation for risk amid rising uncertainty around monetary policy.

stories.headline: Anthropic's Mythos set off a cybersecurity 'hysteria.' Experts say the threat was already here
stories.body: The arrival of Anthropic's Mythos jolted banks, software giants and governments into reckoning with a new era of cyber attacks. But the threat is already here.
